items.title: TX governor: Texas Dems clash with DGA chair Beshear over funding for Hinojosa
items.summary: CNN (published Oct 9) reported Texas Democratic members of Congress and Latino leaders accusing DGA chair Gov. Andy Beshear of shortchanging nominee Gina Hinojosa's bid against Gov. Greg Abbott: the campaign first asked for $10M, then $3M; DGA committed only $1M. Rep. Sylvia Garcia warned Beshear of a 'Latino problem' in 2028. Washington Examiner (Rep-leaning, Oct 11) corroborated with original reporting: former TX Dem chair Gilberto Hinojosa (the nominee's father) says she needs $3-4M more; Abbott has spent $100M+ vs ~$16M for Hinojosa; Gov. Pritzker's PAC added $1M; RCP average had Hinojosa -2; Cook rates the race Leans Abbott. 2028 subtext: seen as early Beshear-vs-Pritzker proxy fight.

items.title: Iowa: Emerson/The Hill poll has Hinson 47-45 Turek in Senate, Sand 49-45 Lahn for governor
items.summary: Emerson College Polling/The Hill (650 LV, Oct 5-6, MoE +/-3.8): Senate Hinson (R) 47, Turek (D) 45; governor Sand (D) 49, Lahn (R) 45. That Senate read conflicts with Suffolk (Oct 1-4): Turek 48-44 — a real pollster split in a tipping-point Senate race — while the Dem governor lead is consistent across four pollsters (Suffolk had Sand 55-43; Fox News 53-44; Marist 54-42). Age split: under-50 voters break Dem by 14-15 pts on both ballots, over-50s break Hinson by 13. Corroborated: The Hill (independent, poll partner) + USA Today + Des Moines Register (battleground-state press) + Fox News poll (third pollster).
items.source_name: The Hill (via KCAU 9) / USA Today / Des Moines Register
